solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **Number in the bottom left = (Product of two right side numbers) + (Number in the top left)**

Let's check,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eed69f22eb6633334112e343b0b75c4ec1832935adc9a73116e4262ffc95c0be.png] 

→ 30 = (9 × 3) + 3

→ 30 = 27 + 3
